## Summary

This iteration of issue #5726 made **no edits to `mondo-edit.obo`**. The Template 1 work (NHA exact matches → add VeNom xrefs and animal-type subsets) was already merged in PR #10145 (commit 7fe96d4), and the remaining Template 2 / Template 3 work cannot be performed safely from this branch.

## What I checked

I audited the current state of `src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo` against the v3 implementation plan in the issue thread:

| Plan item | Expected | Present in repo | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subsetdef:` for 6 VeNom animal-type subsets | 6 | 6 | ✓ |
| `xref: VeNom:...` with `source="MONDO:equivalentTo"` | ~231 | 229 | ✓ (within rounding of v3 curation) |
| Unique Mondo terms receiving VeNom xrefs | ~209 | 209 | ✓ |
| `subset: venom_*` annotations with VeNom source | many | 704 | ✓ |
| `IAO:0000233` linking to issue #5726 on affected terms | 209 | 209 | ✓ |

Commands used:
- `grep -c "^xref: VeNom:" src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo` → 229
- `grep -c "subset: venom_" src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo` → 704
- `grep -c "issues/5726" src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo` → 209
- `obo-grep.pl --noheader -r 'xref: VeNom:' src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo | grep -c "^id: "` → 209
- Spot-checked annotations on `MONDO:0005630` (actinobacillosis), `MONDO:0024971`, and the aleutian-mink-disease record — the xref source qualifier, subset sources, and provenance look correct and match the curation conventions in CLAUDE.md.

## Why I did not attempt Templates 2 and 3

The issue plan for the remaining work depends on curated, human-reviewed input files that are **not in this branch**:

- `data/curated_ROBOT_add_venom_xrefs_human_analogs_v2.tsv` (728 rows — Template 2)
- The Template 3 source TSV (4,076 rows — new NHA terms with no Mondo match)
- Supporting files: `data/venom_diagnosis_terms.tsv`, `data/venom_matching_results.tsv`, the VeNom hierarchy export

`find . -name "*venom*"` and `ls data/` both return nothing. The data folder referenced in the implementation plan is not committed.

The v2 retrospective in the issue thread explicitly documents two systematic matching errors that were only caught during human review (over-aggressive single-word rejection; missing cross-reference against existing NHA terms). Trying to regenerate 728+ term mappings without the reviewed source would be very likely to re-introduce those errors and create incorrect cross-species equivalences — a higher-cost failure than leaving the work for the next iteration that has the curated data in hand.

- [x] Read `__issue_context__.json` and reviewed all six comments / the v3 implementation plan.
- [x] Confirmed prior PR #10145 (commit 7fe96d4) already applies Template 1.
- [x] Audited counts and a sample of stanzas for Template 1 conformance.
- [x] Searched for Template 2 / 3 source data files; none present.
- [x] Decided against fabricating term mappings without curated input.
- [x] No files edited, so nothing to commit on this branch.

## Suggested next step

Commit the curated Template 2 and Template 3 TSVs (plus the VeNom raw extract) under `data/`, then a follow-up iteration can run ROBOT against `mondo_template.tsv` to materialize the new MONDO:1013xxx series and merge them into `mondo-edit.obo`, followed by `sh run.sh make NORM`.
